name: system
description: A software system, as shown on a C4 system context diagram.

name: container
description: A separately runnable or deployable unit, or a data store, within a system.

name: component
description: A grouping of related code within a container.

name: library
description: A library artifact that other code depends on but that is not deployed on its own. It has no C4 level: a library is not a container, and a thin service and its library are drawn as one container.

name: module
description: A build module, such as a Maven module. It has no C4 level: a module is a unit of the build, not a container or component.

name: package
description: A Java package. It has no C4 level: a package is a way to group code, not a component.

name: type
description: A Java class, interface, enum, record or annotation.

name: CONTAINS
description: The subject contains the object, for example a module contains a package.

name: DEPENDS_ON
description: The subject needs the object to build or run.

name: CALLS
description: The subject invokes the object at runtime.

name: EXTENDS
description: The subject type extends the object type.

name: IMPLEMENTS
description: The subject type implements the object interface.
